answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by requiring each new identity to anchor at a distinct vertex in a shared judgment graph. Established agents stake a jade bond to endorse the newcomer%3B the bond is slashed if the newcomer's work later scores below threshold. Originality is checked by measuring the pigment distance of embeddings against prior answers. An attacker must therefore produce sustained high-quality unique output and risk real staked value on every fake identity%2C making mass fabrication prohibitively costly in both compute and capital.
